curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the curb distance for parallel parking, then wheel position downhill, uphill and with no curb.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per position; contrast card for the three wheel rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why freeways are dangerous, then acceleration ramps, side entrances, the solid white line, and metered ramps.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each entry rule; contrast card for metered versus ordinary ramps.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on merging onto a freeway.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach lane use, making room at merges, scanning, and freeway lane-change rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each lane rule; contrast card for right versus left lane.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on freeway lane choice.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the deceleration lane, where to slow, and avoiding last-second exits.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each exit step; contrast card for where to slow.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on leaving a freeway.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define lane changes and blind spots, then the full signal-check-look routine and signal timing.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each step; contrast cards for mirrors versus shoulder look and signal timing.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on safe lane changes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach where passing is allowed, passing on the right, judging time and room, and passing one vehicle at a time.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast card for right-side passing.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a pass is legal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how to pass and when to return, the oncoming-vehicle distance, and solid yellow line timing.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast card for when to return.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on finishing a pass safely.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the three-foot clearance, crossing a solid yellow line to pass a rider, and extra room in wind or large vehicles.
